outlet: Walla Walla Union-Bulletin, "Q&A: Meet the candidates for Columbia County commissioner Position 3" (Jeremy Burnham, 2026-07-18)
notes: Candidate Q&A: both candidates' answers on why they are the right choice, an issue facing the county (Miller: over-taxation; Warren: funds for youth and families, completing the pool project, child care), whether they would abide by the state's sanctuary law (Miller: no, 'Sanctuary laws need to be abolished'; Warren: yes), and serving residents who do not share their beliefs. Says Miller was elected four years ago and is a retired farmer, Warren also a farmer, both Republicans.
